events.name: Tampa Bay Lightning at New York Rangers

headlines.description: — Brandon Hagel scored twice and Jonas Johansson made 12 saves as the Tampa Bay Lighting beat the New York Rangers 4-1 Saturday to extend their winning streak to seven games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hagel scores twice as Lightning beat Rangers 4-1 and extend winning streak to 7 games

headlines.description: — Brock Nelson had two goals and two assists to reach 600 points for his career, Gabriel Landeskog also scored twice, and the Colorado Avalanche beat the Montreal Canadiens 7-2 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brock Nelson has 4 points as surging Avs beat Canadiens 7-2

headlines.description: — Connor McDavid, Leon Draisaitl, Ryan Nugent-Hopkins and Zach Hyman each had a goal and an assist, leading the Edmonton Oilers to a 4-0 victory over the Seattle Kraken on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: McDavid and Draisaitl score as the Oilers beat the Kraken 4-0

events.name: Detroit Red Wings at Boston Bruins

headlines.description: — Jeremy Swayman stopped all three shots he faced in the shootout, and the Boston Bruins beat the Detroit Red Wings 3-2 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Swayman leads the Bruins past the Red Wings 3-2 in a shootout

events.name: Philadelphia Flyers at New Jersey Devils

headlines.description: — Owen Tippett scored two goals and added an assist in the Philadelphia Flyers 5-3 win over the New Jersey Devils on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tippett, Michkov each score twice to lead the Flyers past the Devils 5-3

events.name: Toronto Maple Leafs at Pittsburgh Penguins

headlines.description: — Oliver Ekman-Larsson had a goal and an assist, and the Toronto Maple Leafs beat the Pittsburgh Penguins 7-2 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ekman-Larsson extends point streak as the Maple Leafs rout the Penguins 7-2

headlines.description: — Nino Niederreiter scored twice and the Winnipeg Jets beat the Nashville Predators 5-2 on Saturday night to end a four-game losing streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nino Niederreiter scores twice in the Jets' 5-2 victory over the Predators

events.name: Utah Mammoth at St. Louis Blues

headlines.description: — Dylan Holloway scored, Joel Hofer stopped 17 shots for his second shutout of the season and the St. Louis Blues beat the Utah Mammoth 1-0 on Saturday night in the second half of back-to-back games for both teams.
headlines.shortLinkText: Holloway scores, Hofer makes 17 saves in the Blues' 1-0 win over the Mammoth

headlines.description: — Noah Ostlund scored the winner in a shootout on Saturday night and the Buffalo Sabres snapped the Minnesota Wild's seven-game winning streak with a 3-2 victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sabres snap Wild's 7-game winning streak on Ostlund's shootout goal

events.name: San Jose Sharks at Vegas Golden Knights

headlines.description: — Tomas Hertl scored twice, Carl Lindbom made 18 saves for his first NHL victory and the Vegas Golden Knights beat the San Jose Sharks 4-3 on Saturday night to end a three-game losing streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hertl scores twice, Lindbom gets his 1st NHL win in the Knights' 4-3 victory over the Sharks

events.name: Vancouver Canucks at Los Angeles Kings

headlines.description: — Adrian Kempe scored at 3:58 of overtime and set up Los Angeles' regulation goal to help the Kings beat the Vancouver Canucks 2-1 on Saturday night, extending their points streak to five games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kempe scores in overtime, Forsberg makes 19 saves in Kings' 2-1 win over Canucks
